depends_on.name: subject_id
depends_on.documentation: The subject this interaction is about — the whole specimen whose property was measured or that was acted on (objective annotation rule).

depends_on.name: time_reference_#
depends_on.documentation: When the interaction happened, as one or more time_reference documents (Brainstorm I §1.2: the reference is SHAPED like the data — point / grid / enumerated — so per-sample times are derived, not stored).

fields.name: method
fields.documentation: The verb: what was done (measure, inject, heat, lesion, stimulate). Half of the (method, variable) identity pair (Brainstorm I §1.1, settled). Optional at the schema level because on the observation tier the verb is nearly always 'measurement'; the binding registry is the soft correctness check.

fields.name: variable
fields.documentation: The noun: what the interaction is about — the quantity observed or the entity/factor applied (temperature, body weight, a drug). The queryable fine identity; correctness of variable vs the value's shape is a binding-registry nudge, not a class weld (Brainstorm I, the EPM lesson).

fields.name: target_structure
fields.documentation: Optional locus on the subject: the anatomical structure(s) the act was about, as an ontology term or list (Path T, Locus_Encoding_Paths_Summary #69). Empty for whole-subject records; the subject stays the whole specimen.
